final_draft.note: I couldn't find an approved answer or policy text about a bug bounty programme or vulnerability disclosure policy, so this question needs an answer from the security owner (security@harborlight.example). I searched twice: once for 'bug bounty programme' and once for vulnerability disclosure and reports from outside researchers. Two approved answers are close but don't answer the question: weekly vulnerability scanning with fix times (answer:b21a9e22-ef2c-49f9-b945-67a550dd9cc0) and a yearly penetration test by an independent firm (answer:cfb1c37b-f521-4b1c-aac4-a59e2fdf3d21). Neither says whether a bug bounty exists, so they shouldn't be used to suggest one does or doesn't.

answer:b21a9e22-ef2c-49f9-b945-67a550dd9: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
